entities.name: Heinrich Ritter von Wittek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Heinrich Ritter von Wittek was an Austrian politician of the Christian Social Party (CS). He served as head of the k.k. Railway Ministry and as Minister-President of Cisleithania for four weeks in 1899/1900.
